audit.why: Akali's damage comes from leaving the ring for the empowered, extra-range auto reset — the wind-up is the cue to step back, not the spell cast. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s, which makes the punish window concrete.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] now names Assassin's Mark and the ring-exit reset; phases[3].why carries the 20s Shroud cooldown.

audit.why: Mercury's Treads and Doran's Shield are correct here, and this entry does NOT carry the templated Grievous Wounds line the mirror audit flagged on other Akali pages — Akali has no healing in her kit.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Akali contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Your Q auto-weave out-damages her Five Point Strike poke at 1 — Twilight Shroud is not up yet, so she has no way to break the trade.

edits.before: E shield lets you take a trade and refund his answer. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: Ki Burst at 2 is your window — with no shroud she cannot dodge a point-blank stun, so step up and force the trade.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twilight Shroud's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1) now swallows your Ki Burst and your burst window; she picks the trades, so give ground and farm safe.
